scripts.api: cd backend && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000
scripts.setup:api: cd backend && uv sync && uv run alembic upgrade head
scripts.seed: cd backend && uv run python -m app.seed
scripts.check:api: cd backend && uv run ruff check app tests alembic scripts && uv run ruff format --check app tests alembic scripts && uv run mypy app && uv run pytest -q && uv run alembic check
scripts.check:postgres: cd backend && uv run python -m scripts.check_postgres
scripts.check: npm run contract:check && npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build && npm run check:api
